papers.title: Virtual Knockout in the Era of Generative AI: From Intracellular Networks to Spatial and Cross-Modal Functional Simulations.
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation data have enabled computational models that predict intervention-associated cellular responses. This narrative review organizes explicit gene-regulatory-network simulations, latent and compositional response models, graph, optimal-transport, and dynamical approaches, foundation-model representations, and emerging spatial or cross-modal settings through a virtual-knockout lens. We distinguish representation-level ablation from causal genetic intervention and separate held-out regimes for genes, cell types or contexts, perturbation combinations, chemical structures, and doses. We compare representative methods, experimental resources, metrics, and benchmark frameworks and operationally define a prospective holographic virtual cell by its modalities, regulatory and physical constraints, intervention-conditioned outputs with calibrated uncertainty, and prospective validation requirements. The holographic virtual cell and Design-Build-Test-Learn roadmap are presented as future-facing criteria rather than as an achieved clinical capability.

summary.takeaway: 这篇叙述性综述以“虚拟敲除”为线索，系统梳理单细胞扰动响应预测的计算模型，并提出“全息虚拟细胞”的展望性标准。
summary.methods: 综述整合显式基因调控网络模拟、潜变量与组合响应模型、图模型、最优传输与动力学方法、基础模型表示，以及空间与跨模态设置，并区分表示层消融与因果遗传干预及不同留出评估设定。
summary.relevance: 直接关联单细胞扰动、虚拟细胞及跨模态理解与生成，为扰动数据建模与虚拟细胞评估提供概念框架。
summary.caveat: 属叙述性综述，未提出新方法或新实验；“全息虚拟细胞”与DBTL路线图仅为前瞻性标准，摘要明确其非已实现的临床能力。

papers.title: BoolFunc-EA: A Boolean-evolutionary approach for accurate inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data.
papers.abstract: Network inference is the process of discovering genetic information from time-series data. The inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series data represents a significant challenge in bioinformatics. Despite the development of many Boolean network inference methods, most struggle with scalability as they impose restrictions on regulatory genes for each target gene. Other methods suffer from local optimum issues or are unable to compute the exact mutual information between a regulatory gene and its target gene. To resolve these issues, we present a novel method referred to as BoolFunc-EA, which employs Boolean functions and a genetic algorithm to infer gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data. BoolFunc-EA is a two-stage algorithm. First, we employ a set of limited Boolean functions to search for a regulatory gene. If a regulatory gene is not identified at this stage, a genetic algorithm is applied to determine a set of regulatory genes. In particular, this study introduces a hybrid crossover operator and a new fitness function that enhances information inheritance, improves solution evaluation, and provides a more effective solution representation within the proposed genetic algorithm framework. To assess the effectiveness of BoolFunc-EA, we conducted a wide range of experiments on both artificial and real gene expression datasets. Findings from the artificial dataset reveal that BoolFunc-EA consistently outperforms benchmark methods, including LogicGEP, LogBTF, MIBNI, LBF-MI, CLR, RelNet, Genie3-time, dynGenie3, and Jump3. The proposed method was further evaluated on the budding yeast cell cycle network and on fifty gene regulatory network datasets generated using the GNW tool. Its performance was then compared with that of nine benchmark methods. Results from real gene expression datasets also show that BoolFunc-EA consistently achieves superior F-score values, even on biological networks. Taken together, BoolFunc-EA is an efficient, scalable, and robust tool for gene regulatory network inference. The source code and reproducible experimental results are freely accessible at https://github.com/Dr-Shohag-Barman/BoolFunc-EA.

summary.takeaway: 提出BoolFunc-EA，用布尔函数与遗传算法从时间序列表达数据推断基因调控网络，在人工和真实数据上多数优于所列基准。
summary.methods: 两阶段算法：先用有限布尔函数搜索调控基因，失败则用遗传算法确定调控基因集合，并引入混合交叉算子与新适应度函数；在人工数据集、芽殖酵母细胞周期网络及GNW生成的50个GRN数据集上评测。
summary.relevance: 面向GRN/Regulon推断，针对现有布尔网络方法可扩展性差、易陷局部最优及互信息计算不精确等问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告F-score等相对优势，未给出具体数值；性能依赖基准数据集设定，独立复现与更广泛真实网络验证需参考原文及代码。

papers.title: Intragenic redistribution of RNA polymerase II licenses epigenetic silencing
papers.abstract: Co-transcriptional chromatin regulation is widely recognized as a mechanism that reinforces active gene expression, yet transcriptionally active genes must also be able to transition into stable epigenetic silencing during developmental transitions and environmental responses. Whether and how ongoing transcription is coupled to the initiation of epigenetic silencing remains unclear. Here we show that elongating RNA polymerase II phosphorylated at Ser2 (RNAPII-Ser2P) functions as an instructive signal for epigenetic silencing initiation. At actively transcribed genes, RNAPII-Ser2P positions and spatially constrains the FLD-LD H3K4me1 demethylase complex near transcription termination regions, separating the complex from its gene-body H3K4me1 substrate. We found that both chemical perturbation of transcription and physiological silencing cues induce a redistribution of RNAPII-Ser2P into the gene body, accompanied by FLD relocalization and subsequent gene-body H3K4me1 erasure. FLD disengages from chromatin upon gene silencing, indicating that active transcription is required for its continued chromatin association. We further show that LD tethers FLD to RNAPII through an N-terminal HOX domain that binds the C-terminal region of FLD and an adjacent TFIIS domain that contacts the RNAPII CTD in a Ser2P-sensitive manner. This FLD-LD-RNAPII bridge is essential to promote H3K4me1 erasure and gene silencing. Together, these findings reveal a mechanism by which active transcription licenses the initiation of epigenetic silencing.

summary.takeaway: 提出延伸中RNAPII-Ser2P作为表观沉默起始的指令信号：它在活跃转录基因上把FLD-LD H3K4me1去甲基化酶复合物限制在终止区附近，转录扰动或沉默 cues 使其向基因体重新分布并擦除H3K4me1。
summary.methods: 在活跃转录基因上定位RNAPII-Ser2P与FLD-LD复合物，结合化学扰动转录与生理沉默信号，检测FLD重定位与基因体H3K4me1擦除，并解析LD的HOX域与TFIIS域介导的FLD-LD-RNAPII桥接。
summary.relevance: 匹配主题标注为检索增强与对齐，但摘要内容为共转录染色质调控机制，与检索增强或对齐方法的直接关联在摘要中未体现。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要为机制性发现，未说明具体生物体系与定量效应大小；匹配主题与内容存在张力，跨主题相关性需谨慎。

papers.title: IL-15 superagonist induces robust STAT5 phosphorylation to support the differentiation and survival of tumor-relevant memory precursor effector-like CD8 T cells, enhancing long-term antitumor protection
papers.abstract: The tumor-draining lymph node (tdLN) serves as a critical reservoir of tumor-reactive T cells, yet its contribution to preventing metastatic recurrence remains poorly understood. In this study, we investigate CD8 T cell clonal dynamics and memory responses induced by neoadjuvant anti PD-1 therapy. We demonstrate that PD-1 blockade promotes the emergence of protective CD8 T cell memory, enriched with tumor-relevant clones that persist in the lymph nodes of long-term survivors. Furthermore, we show that combination of a neoadjuvant IL-15 superagonist with PD-1 blockade significantly increases clonal diversity, cytotoxicity, and clonal persistence in non-draining lymph nodes. These changes result in enhanced systemic antitumor immunity and durable memory that prevents tumor relapse. Our findings establish the tdLN as a critical immunologic hub that can be therapeutically targeted by IL-15 to augment PD-1 blockade efficacy and support a rationale for a phase II neoadjuvant combination immunotherapy trial in early-stage NSCLC.

summary.takeaway: 新辅助IL-15超激动剂联合PD-1阻断可增强肿瘤引流淋巴结中肿瘤反应性CD8 T细胞的克隆多样性、细胞毒性与克隆持续，形成持久记忆并防止复发。
summary.methods: 研究新辅助抗PD-1治疗下CD8 T细胞克隆动态与记忆反应，比较IL-15超激动剂联合PD-1阻断对非引流淋巴结中克隆多样性、细胞毒性和持续性的影响，并观察长期保护。
summary.relevance: 匹配主题标注为检索增强与对齐，但摘要为肿瘤免疫学实验研究，未涉及检索增强或对齐方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出模型系统、样本量与统计细节；主题匹配与内容不符，不宜据此推断方法学关联。

papers.title: Beta-Myosin inhibition in skeletal muscle: Impact of Mavacamten on the diaphragm
papers.abstract: The diaphragm, a primary respiratory muscle, contains nearly equal proportions of slow, Type-1 and fast, Type-II muscle fibers. Muscle fiber types - classified based on their shortening velocities and force generation abilities - are largely determined by distinct myosin II isoforms. Mavacamten (MAVA), a small molecule inhibitor of beta-cardiac myosin ATPase, is currently used for the treatment of obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HOCM). Notably, beta-myosin heavy chain (beta-MyHC) is not restricted to the ventricular myocardium but is also expressed in slow fibers, raising concerns about off-target effects of therapy used to treat cardiomyopathic conditions. Given that nearly 50 % of the fibers express beta-MyHC in the diaphragm, we hypothesize that Mava may affect diaphragm muscle activity. Using an in vitro motility assay, we investigated the effects of Mava on native myosins isolated from rabbit diaphragm muscle and measured the velocity of actin and regulated thin filaments. Mava caused a dose-dependent decrease in myosin-driven actin filament velocity, with an apparent IC50 of 1350 nM. Importantly, this inhibition was reversible upon drug washout, indicating a non-permanent modulatory effect. To determine the drugs fiber-type specificity, we tested pure slow- and fast-myosin isoforms from the slow-twitch M. soleus and fast-twitch M. psoas. Both isoforms were inhibited by Mava, but slow myosin exhibited nearly 20-fold greater sensitivity than fast myosin, suggesting a potentially stronger impact on slow fibers. Interestingly, the slow myosin isoform showed even higher sensitivity to Mava than beta-cardiac myosin. Further mechanistic analysis distinguished two modes of action: (i) promotion of the OFF state of myosin, likely reducing a pool of active motors interacting with actin filaments, and (ii) modulation of the actomyosin biochemical cycle. Altogether, given the diaphragms reliance on both fiber types for sustained respiratory function, this off-target effect may impair respiratory performance in patients undergoing therapy, underscoring the need for respiratory function monitoring. The studies have direct implications for understanding the modulation of myosin function under physiological and pathophysiological conditions, as well as following pharmacological interventions.

summary.takeaway: Mavacamten可剂量依赖性、可逆地抑制膈肌肌球蛋白驱动 actin 丝滑动，且慢肌球蛋白敏感性约为快肌球蛋白的20倍，提示对呼吸肌的脱靶效应风险。
summary.methods: 用体外 motility assay 检测兔膈肌天然肌球蛋白及比目鱼肌（慢）与腰大肌（快）纯化肌球蛋白亚型在Mavacamten下的 actin 与调节细丝速度，并做机制分析区分OFF态促进与 actomyosin 周期调控。
summary.relevance: 匹配主题标注为检索增强与对齐，但摘要为药理学与肌肉生理研究，与检索增强或对齐无直接方法关联。
summary.caveat: 摘要为体外实验，未提供在体呼吸功能数据；对患者呼吸性能的影响属推断，需临床监测研究验证；主题匹配与内容不符。

papers.title: Improving Target-Adverse Event Association Prediction via Inverse Node Frequency Transformation to Mitigate Knowledge Graph Topological Bias
papers.abstract: Motivation: Identifying significant associations between therapeutic protein targets and adverse events (AEs) is a critical component of drug safety assessment. To accelerate the process, machine learning methods have been developed to predict these associations as edges in network data integrating molecular interactions and other key biomedical knowledge. However, these networks often suffer from topological imbalances where a minority of "hub" nodes determine the predictive signal. This "topological" or "degree bias" can lead to poor performance on novel or understudied targets where safety inference is most needed. Results: We introduce Inverse Node Frequency (INF), a generally applicable node degree-based approach for mitigating topological bias. Employing an enriched biomedical knowledge graph and our own carefully curated target-adverse event associations, we apply INF as a normalisation procedure on a class of graph-derived features called metapaths and evaluate their resulting target-AE association prediction performance. Our results demonstrate that INF significantly improves the true positive rate (TPR/recall) for low-degree targets compared to the untransformed metapath features as well as a popular established normalisation method, while also achieving highly competitive hits@k, a ranking-based metric for knowledge graph-based inference. We also evaluated INF on an external set of target-AE associations never before used for modelling, on which INF also showed superior resilience compared to the two benchmarks.

summary.takeaway: 提出逆节点频率（INF）归一化以缓解知识图谱中度偏置，提升低度靶点-不良事件关联预测的真阳性率，并在外部集上保持韧性。
summary.methods: 在富集生物医学知识图谱与自建靶点-AE关联上，将INF作为基于节点度的归一化应用于metapath特征，比较未变换特征与常用归一化方法，评估TPR/recall与hits@k。
summary.relevance: 直接对应知识图谱主题，关注图拓扑偏置对靶点安全性推断的影响。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体提升幅度与数据集规模；外部验证集仍有限，方法对其他知识图谱与任务的泛化需进一步评估。

papers.title: FUSE: FUsing EEG-MEG in a Shared Embedding via self-supervised learning for BCI
papers.abstract: Combining complementary neurophysiological modalities offers a promising strategy for improving motor imagery (MI) brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), but learning shared representations across modalities remains largely unexplored. Here, we propose a two-phase deep learning framework for multimodal EEG-MEG decoding that explicitly decouples representation learning from downstream classification. In the first phase, a convolutional encoder-decoder learns a shared latent representation by predicting the power spectral density (PSD) of EEG and MEG signals directly from time-domain activity, rather than using the conventional objective of reconstructing the input signal. In the second phase, the encoder is frozen and its learned representations are reused, without further adaptation, to perform the classification of the downstream MI-BCI task. The framework was evaluated on simultaneous EEG and MEG recordings from 20 participants. The learned representations consistently outperformed conventional handcrafted spectral features, increasing median classification accuracy from 0.734 to 0.794. The multimodal framework also improved performance over MEG alone (median accuracy from 0.680 to 0.794) and yielded a modest increase over EEG alone (median accuracy from 0.765 to 0.794), providing a more robust decoding strategy than single-modality approaches. Furthermore, the learned latent representations were transferable across participants, with more than half of cross-subject models performing within 0.01 accuracy of their subject-specific counterparts. These findings demonstrate that task-agnostic representation learning can capture physiologically meaningful multimodal neural representations that remain transferable across individuals, offering a promising foundation for more robust and reusable BCI pipelines.

summary.takeaway: 提出两阶段EEG-MEG共享嵌入框架FUSE：以预测功率谱密度为自监督目标学习共享潜表示，冻结编码器后用于运动想象分类，多模态优于手工谱特征并具跨被试可迁移性。
summary.methods: 卷积编码器-解码器从时域活动预测EEG与MEG的PSD以学习共享潜空间；第二阶段冻结编码器做下游MI-BCI分类；在20名参与者的同步EEG-MEG记录上评估，并与单模态及跨被试比较。
summary.relevance: 直接关联自监督与表示学习，并涉及跨模态共享表示用于BCI解码。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告中位准确率提升，但样本为20人；跨被试迁移仅部分模型接近个体化水平，未涵盖其他任务或更多模态。

papers.title: Candidate gene mining of a fragmented Tipularia discolor Pursh (Nutt.) genome assembly reveals genes putatively associated with specialized metabolite production.
papers.abstract: Orchids are a large and diverse group of plants with unique adaptations that have enabled the utilization of many different environmental habitats across almost all continents. These adaptations are mediated by an as-yet-underexplored genetic resource. Nearly all sequenced orchid genomes are of Asian origin and represent less than 0.1% of all orchid species, limiting the ability to explore and mine the gene space of this complex plant family. Greater representation of orchids in genome databases could provide important insights into the genes responsible for adaptive phenotypes, which could be useful for targeted crop improvement and in orchid conservation efforts. To begin to expand the palette of orchid genomes, an effort was undertaken to sequence the genome of a North American terrestrial orchid, Tipularia discolor. K-mer analysis estimated a haploid genome size of approximately 1.7 Gb, with a high proportion of repetitive sequences. Although a complete genome was not obtained, the implementation of a conservative gene mining approach and the generation of a candidate gene mining pipeline led to the identification of 68 consensus contig objects containing whole or partial genes related to sucrose, trehalose, terpenoid, and phenylpropanoid metabolism. Of note, two bibenzyl synthase homologs were identified with high confidence and clustered with characterized orchid bibenzyl synthases in a CHS/BBS phylogeny, indicating that T. discolor, like its Asian and South American relatives, has the capacity to produce this distinct class of phenylpropanoids. Thus, despite substantial fragmentation, the T. discolor assembly contains sufficient gene space representation for targeted candidate gene discovery. This works lays the foundation for functional characterization of selected candidates and development of a more complete genome assembly for comparative genomic studies.

summary.takeaway: 对北美陆生兰花Tipularia discolor 的碎片化基因组组装进行候选基因挖掘，鉴定出与蔗糖、海藻糖、萜类及苯丙烷代谢相关的68个共识contig对象，并高置信识别两个bibenzyl synthase同源基因。
summary.methods: k-mer分析估计单倍体基因组约1.7 Gb且重复序列比例高；采用保守基因挖掘流程与候选基因挖掘管线，结合CHS/BBS系统发育聚类鉴定候选基因。
summary.relevance: 匹配主题标注为检索增强与对齐，但摘要为基因组资源与基因挖掘研究，未涉及检索增强或对齐方法。
summary.caveat: 未获得完整基因组，组装高度碎片化；候选基因仅基于序列与系统发育推断，功能未验证；主题匹配与内容不符。

papers.title: A Hierarchical KAN-Augmented Graph Convolutional Model for Inferring Cell-Type-Specific Gene Regulations in Single-Cell Omics.
papers.abstract: Accurate inference of gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell RNA-seq data remains challenging due to the complexity of transcription factor (TF)-target interactions and the difficulty in capturing both local and global regulatory dependencies. Here, we present GeneKAN, a novel deep learning framework that integrates multiscale graph convolution with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for robust GRN inference. GeneKAN employs a kernel-based graph convolution module to hierarchically encode gene representations, while KANs model high-order, interpretable TF-target relationships through learnable spline activations. Benchmarking against eleven existing models, and seven scRNA-seq datasets from BEELINE, including diverse cell types, species, and ground-truth networks (ChIP-seq, STRING, LOF/GOF), demonstrates that our proposed GeneKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in both AUROC and AUPRC. Ablation studies of the proposed model confirm the necessity of each component. Biological validation on human hepatocyte and lung cancer datasets reveals that GeneKAN not only recovers known regulatory interactions with high precision but also identifies functionally relevant hub genes and oncogenic pathways. GeneKAN thus offers a powerful, interpretable, and scalable solution for GRN reconstruction under real-world conditions of data sparsity and noise, with significant potential for advancing systems biology and precision medicine.

summary.takeaway: 提出 GeneKAN，一种结合多尺度图卷积与 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 的深度学习框架，用于从单细胞 RNA-seq 数据推断基因调控网络。
summary.methods: 使用基于核的图卷积模块分层编码基因表示，KAN 通过可学习样条激活建模高阶可解释的 TF-靶标关系；在 BEELINE 的七个 scRNA-seq 数据集上与十一个现有模型进行基准比较，并进行消融实验和生物学验证。
summary.relevance: 直接针对 GRN/Regulon 主题，提供从单细胞数据推断调控网络的新方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了 AUROC 和 AUPRC 上的最优性能，但未提供具体数值；生物学验证限于人肝细胞和肺癌数据集，泛化性需进一步评估。

papers.title: Gene regulatory networks and the organization of cell differentiation in multicellular organisms
papers.abstract: Across their development, clonal multicellular organisms generate new cell types from less differentiated cell types. Differentiation pathways arrange into a hierarchical, tree-like organization: regressions from specialized to undifferentiated cell types rarely occur and undifferentiated cell types often have the potential to produce, when subject to distinct stimuli, two or more differently specialized cell types. How cell type transitions acquire such a peculiar disposition requires an explanation that must reside in the properties of gene regulatory networks (GRNs); after all, GRNs orchestrate the changes in gene activity that define cell types. We studied vast numbers of small dynamic model networks to search for elementary GRNs that could yield the simplest hierarchical, developmental-like, differentiation patterns. We found that only a small minority of GRNs are compatible with hierarchical cell type transitions. Importantly, GRNs that yielded developmental-like differentiation patterns shared common traits: One is the presence of tangles of cycles of positive interactions. Genes in such a tangle produce an all-or-none one-way response to a signal. Another such trait is mutual inhibition between genes associated to different specialized cell types, enforcing their mutually exclusive activation. Moreover, these regulatory patterns are more abundant in published experimentally sustained developmental GRNs than as expected by chance. In addition, we show that it is easy to maintain hierarchical cellular differentiation throughout evolution, even when undergoing changes in gene regulatory interactions and developmental mechanisms. Our work supports the prevalence of design principles that organize hierarchically differentiation pathways in clonal multicellular organisms.

summary.takeaway: 通过大规模小规模动态网络模型搜索，发现只有少数 GRN 能产生层级性细胞分化模式，并识别出正相互作用环的缠结和互抑制等共同特征。
summary.methods: 研究大量小型动态模型网络，寻找能产生最简单层级发育样分化模式的基本 GRN；并比较已发表的实验支持发育 GRN 中这些调控模式的富集程度。
summary.relevance: 与 GRN/Regulon 主题相关，探讨 GRN 结构如何组织多细胞生物中的细胞分化层级。
summary.caveat: 基于小规模模型网络的模拟研究，结论主要来自计算分析，实验验证有限。

papers.title: Organ context dominates cell identity across a multi-organ single-cell atlas of grapevine
papers.abstract: How transcriptional programs defining cell identity are maintained or remodeled across organ contexts remains a fundamental question in plant biology, particularly in long-lived perennials. We generated a multi-organ single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of the dwarf grapevine cultivar Pixie, comprising over 220,000 nuclei from nine organs across vegetative and reproductive development, each sampled in two biological replicates. We annotated 46 distinct cell types and anatomical structures, reconstructed developmental trajectories within selected cell types, and inferred gene regulatory networks at cell-type resolution. Organ identity accounted for 65% of regulon activity variance across the atlas compared to only 17% for cell type, demonstrating that organ context is the dominant driver of transcriptional variation in most shared cell types. Broadly distributed cell types including epidermis and xylem parenchyma underwent extensive organ-specific reprogramming, while companion cells maintained organ-independent regulatory programs across all nine organs, representing the stable end of a continuum of transcriptional plasticity. This finding suggests that companion cell identity is buffered against organ context, consistent with their invariant role in phloem loading. This atlas establishes a reference framework for dissecting gene regulatory network organization across organs in a perennial crop and provides a resource for cell-type-resolved functional genomics in grapevine and other woody perennials.

summary.takeaway: 构建葡萄藤多器官单核转录组图谱，发现器官身份解释的 regulon 活性方差远高于细胞类型，表明器官背景是共享细胞类型转录变异的主要驱动因素。
summary.methods: 对矮化葡萄品种 Pixie 的九个器官生成超过 220,000 个细胞核的单核转录组图谱，每个器官两个生物学重复；注释 46 种细胞类型，重建发育轨迹并在细胞类型分辨率推断 GRN。
summary.relevance: 与 GRN/Regulon 主题相关，在多年生作物中解析跨器官的调控网络组织。
summary.caveat: 研究限于单一葡萄品种和特定发育阶段；器官背景主导的结论基于该图谱的方差分解，其他物种或条件需验证。

papers.title: Sensory-processing traits generate dietary phenotypes that predict microbiome structure: an agent-based modelling framework
papers.abstract: Differences in gut microbiome composition are frequently reported across neurodevelopmental and psychiatric conditions, including autism and depression, and are often interpreted as reflecting underlying neurobiological variation. However, dietary behaviour is both a major determinant of microbiome composition and a downstream consequence of sensory and cognitive processes. To investigate whether microbiome differences can emerge through behavioural pathways alone, I developed a minimal agent-based model linking sensory-processing traits, dietary behaviour, and microbiome structure. Agents were characterised by latent sensory drive, predictability preference, and context sensitivity, which influenced food selection through reinforcement learning and stochastic environmental interactions. Continuous variation in these traits generated a broad spectrum of dietary phenotypes ranging from restrictive to exploratory food-selection strategies. Dietary entropy increased strongly with dietary repertoire size and was associated with reduced microbiome dominance, indicating that more diverse diets produced more even microbial communities. Sensory-processing traits initially appeared to predict microbiome structure directly; however, when dietary entropy was incorporated into the analysis, the direct effects of sensory traits were greatly reduced, while dietary entropy emerged as the dominant predictor of microbiome dominance. Incorporating dietary entropy increased explanatory power from R2 = 0.67 to R2 = 0.99. Sensitivity analyses demonstrated that this dietary filtering mechanism was robust across a wide range of assumptions regarding microbiome persistence, reinforcement learning, and choice stochasticity. These findings suggest that dietary filtering provides a plausible mechanism linking sensory-processing characteristics to microbiome structure and may explain at least some microbiome differences reported across gut-brain studies. Integrating sensory, behavioural, dietary, and microbiome data may therefore be essential for improving causal inference within gut-brain axis research.

summary.takeaway: 开发一个最小代理模型，表明感官处理特征可通过饮食行为影响肠道微生物组结构，饮食熵是微生物组优势度的主导预测因子。
summary.methods: 构建基于代理的模型，代理具有潜在感官驱动、可预测性偏好和情境敏感性，通过强化学习和随机环境交互影响食物选择；分析饮食表型与微生物组结构的关系，并进行敏感性分析。
summary.relevance: 与机制推理和强化学习主题相关，展示行为路径如何介导感官特征与微生物组差异之间的关联。
summary.caveat: 模型为最小化代理模拟，结论基于模拟数据而非实证观察；饮食熵解释力的提升（R2 从 0.67 到 0.99）需在真实数据中验证。

papers.title: CsrA-dependent RNA accessibility landscapes prioritize new mRNA and sRNA targets and link CsrA to polyphosphate homeostasis
papers.abstract: The global RNA-binding protein CsrA (Carbon Storage Regulatory Protein A) regulates diverse physiological processes in Gammaproteobacteria, but the full set of RNAs through which it actuates and how they intersect with small RNA (sRNA) regulation and stress physiology remain incompletely defined. We asked how CsrA shapes RNA accessibility across 431 untranslated mRNA regions and 87 sRNAs in Escherichia coli. Using a previously published RNA accessibility profiling method (INTERFACE), we compared wild type and CsrA mutant (csrA::kan) strains. Permissive screening for accessibility peaks at GGA/AGA motifs nominated 87 5'UTRs, 32 3'UTRs and 28 sRNAs as candidate responsive RNAs but did not pass a permutation null (p=0.43), however it can be used to guide selection of candidates for validation. Eleven 5'UTRs had no prior experimental evidence, and all 3'UTRs and most sRNAs were nominated manually because of limited probe numbers in these targets. In reporter assays, six of nine RNAs tested showed CsrA-dependent expression (mdtE, ribB, patA, metC, ppk and proS) including three candidate activated-targets, although only two of five reporters from the primary candidate list responded. CsrA bound the sRNAs SsrA and RalA in vitro, and reporter assays suggested CsrA-dependent modulation of previously identified ArrS-ribB and GcvB-crp interactions. Mutating sequence elements in the ppk 5' UTR altered CsrA-dependent expression, and loss of CsrA-activity was associated with reduced polyphosphate and fewer Hfq-containing HP-bodies during nitrogen starvation. Together, these findings expand the CsrA regulon and its overlap with sRNA networks, and support accessibility profiling to prioritize RNA-binding protein targets for follow-up characterization.

summary.takeaway: 利用 RNA 可及性谱分析扩展大肠杆菌中 CsrA 的调控子，提名新的 mRNA 和 sRNA 靶标，并发现 CsrA 与多聚磷酸稳态的关联。
summary.methods: 使用 INTERFACE 方法比较野生型和 csrA 突变株在 431 个 mRNA 非翻译区和 87 个 sRNA 中的 RNA 可及性；通过报告基因实验验证候选靶标，并进行体外结合实验和序列突变分析。
summary.relevance: 与 GRN/Regulon 和检索增强与对齐主题相关，提供 RNA 结合蛋白靶标优先筛选的策略。
summary.caveat: 初始可及性峰筛选未通过置换检验（p=0.43）；报告基因实验中仅部分候选靶标响应，且 3'UTR 和多数 sRNA 因探针有限为手动提名。

papers.title: High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Millimeter-Scale Malignant Territories and Immune Exclusion patterns in Human Salivary Gland Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC) of the salivary gland (SGACC) is a rare malignancy with frequent late recurrence and limited response to systemic and immune therapies. Bulk and single-cell sequencing do not preserve tissue architecture, so the spatial organization of its MYB-driven myoepithelial and luminal tumor cells, stroma, and immune cells remains poorly defined. This study aimed to map the SGACC tumor microenvironment at near-cellular resolution. Methods: Visium HD based spatial transcriptomics was performed on four SGACC tissue sections from three patients with tubulo-cribriform tumor form in stage III - IV. Bins of 10 x 10 {micro}m were annotated and deconvolved with cell2location using an integrated single-cell reference of 119,189 cells from 20 donors. Pseudobulk differential expression, spatial autocorrelation, potency and spatial trajectory inference, permutation-based territory analysis, Hotspot module detection, and marker-based immune profiling were applied. Results: MYB-expressing luminal (LECs-MYB) and myoepithelial (MECs-MYB) epithelial cells occupied 55.7% of bins on average. The MECs-MYB to LECs-MYB ratio increased from the nest interior toward the tumor edge, where cancer-associated fibroblasts rose sharply. Potency and trajectory analyses placed MECs-MYB upstream of LECs-MYB. Malignant states formed territories of up to 38.0 mm2 that persisted over 1.5 mm in three sections and contained spatially restricted programs. Hypoxic stressed territories also showed mTORC1, unfolded protein response, and cell-cycle programs. T/NK, myeloid, MHC class I and II, and plasma cell signatures were 1.4- to 5.7-fold higher in stroma than in tumor nests, whereas VTCN1 (B7-H4) was the only B7 family ligand enriched within nests. Conclusions: SGACC shows an ordered arrangement of malignant lineages, millimeter-scale malignant territories, MHC class - I and II enriched stroma, and immune-excluded nests enriched for B7-H4. These features provide evidence to be validated in larger cohorts with protein-level and clinical data.

summary.takeaway: 利用高分辨率空间转录组学揭示唾液腺腺样囊性癌中毫米级恶性区域、免疫排斥模式以及 B7-H4 在瘤巢中的富集。
summary.methods: 对三名患者的四份组织切片进行 Visium HD 空间转录组学，使用 cell2location 和单细胞参考进行反卷积，应用伪 bulk 差异表达、空间自相关、轨迹推断、区域分析和免疫分析。
summary.relevance: 与检索增强与对齐主题相关，展示空间转录组学在解析肿瘤微环境组织中的应用。
summary.caveat: 样本量小（三名患者、四份切片），结论需在更大队列中通过蛋白水平和临床数据验证。

papers.title: TrES-seq integrates single-cell RNA and nanobody-based histone mark profiles to decode epigenetic and transcriptional axes of cell identity
papers.abstract: Histone post-translational modifications and gene expression jointly shape cellular identity and activity. However, systematically assessing their heterogeneity and functional interdependence requires high-quality multimodal single-cell readouts, whose generation still faces significant technological challenges. Here, we developed TrES-seq (transcriptional and epigenetic state sequencing), a method that integrates scRNA-seq with species-specific nanobody Tn5 fusion proteins to jointly profile RNA and two histone modifications in the same cells and across multiple samples. In human tonsils, single-cell H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K9me3, and RNA data in >25,000 cells revealed a one-to-many relationship where heterogeneous transcriptional states shared similar epigenetic profiles. For example, naive and memory B cells were transcriptionally different but epigenetically indistinguishable, while the epigenetic status of enhancers but not promoters separated germinal center from naive and memory B cells. Moreover, naturally occurring and treatment-induced cell state transitions revealed broad transcriptional changes occurring among genes that already exhibited and retained an epigenetically active state. Overall, TrES-seq provides a robust and cost-effective platform to determine how epigenetic states influence transcriptional heterogeneity, shaping cell phenotypes and function in different physiological and pathological contexts.

summary.takeaway: 开发 TrES-seq 方法，整合 scRNA-seq 与基于纳米抗体的组蛋白修饰谱，揭示转录异质性与表观遗传状态之间的一对多关系。
summary.methods: 使用物种特异性纳米抗体 Tn5 融合蛋白，在同一细胞中联合分析 RNA 和两种组蛋白修饰；在人扁桃体中分析超过 25,000 个细胞的 H3K27ac、H3K27me3、H3K9me3 和 RNA 数据。
summary.relevance: 与多组学扰动主题相关，提供多模态单细胞读出来解析细胞身份的表观遗传和转录轴。
summary.caveat: 研究限于人扁桃体样本和特定组蛋白修饰；方法在更广泛细胞类型和条件下的适用性需进一步测试。

papers.title: MicroBioAgent: an AI agent for automated microbiome analysis
papers.abstract: Microbiome data analysis demands customized workflows tailored to specific biological questions, sequencing modalities, and data properties. However, constructing and executing these workflows requires navigating heterogeneous software dependencies, reference databases, and multi-step parameter tuning. Here, we present MicroBioAgent, an autonomous, domain-specific agent framework that translates high-level biological queries into executable, study-specific pipelines across 16S rRNA amplicon, reference-based shotgun, and de novo assembly-based metagenomics. Rather than relying on static pipeline templates, MicroBioAgent employs a closed-loop execution architecture: it dynamically selects and runs bioinformatics tools within user-controlled environments while iteratively inspecting intermediate outputs to adapt downstream analytical decisions. Furthermore, to address the long-running nature of metagenomic computation, we introduce an asynchronous background task-management mechanism that reduces LLM token consumption by over 50% while enabling real-time plan adjustment and automated workflow resumption. We systematically evaluated MicroBioAgent across three benchmarks of increasing complexity: (1) paired amplicon and shotgun profiling of tomato rhizosphere microbiomes, (2) taxonomic and functional profiling coupled with machine-learning classification in a colorectal cancer cohort, and (3) de novo metagenomic assembly, metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) binning, and metabolic pathway reconstruction in a polyethylene degradation study. Across all benchmarks, MicroBioAgent faithfully recapitulated the primary biological findings of the original studies, exhibiting high analytical concordance despite expected tool- and database-dependent variations. In systematic robustness evaluations across 27 independent runs spanning three backbone large language models and three prompt-complexity tiers, MicroBioAgent achieved a 98.8% task completion rate and yielded highly reproducible diversity and differential-abundance estimates. MicroBioAgent establishes a scalable, adaptive paradigm for end-to-end computational microbiome research.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MicroBioAgent，一个自主领域特定代理框架，将高层生物学查询转化为可执行的微生物组分析流程，并在多个基准中复现主要生物学发现。
summary.methods: 采用闭环执行架构，动态选择并运行生物信息学工具，迭代检查中间输出以调整下游分析；引入异步后台任务管理机制；在三个复杂度递增的基准中评估，并跨三种大语言模型和三种提示复杂度进行鲁棒性测试。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型主题相关，展示 LLM 代理在自动化计算微生物组研究中的应用。
summary.caveat: 评估限于三个基准研究；尽管任务完成率达 98.8%，工具和数据库依赖的变异仍存在，需在更广泛场景中验证。

papers.title: Prevalence of autoimmune hepatitis in patients with Sjögren disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Sjögren disease (SjD) and autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) may coexist, but the prevalence of AIH in SjD patients is unclear. This study investigated the prevalence and association. METHODS: Databases (Web of Science, Cochrane, Embase, PubMed, CNKI, Wanfang, CBMdisc, VIP) were searched up to November 14, 2025. Quality was assessed using NOS and JBI scales. Meta-analysis was performed with R 4.5.2 (PROSPERO: CRD420251233495). RESULTS: Fourteen studies (3697 SjD patients) were included. Overall prevalence of AIH in SjD was 2.55% (95% CI: 1.52%-4.26%). Prevalence varied by study type (retrospective cohort: 4.58%, cross-sectional: 1.72%, prospective cohort: 1.67%) and by country (China: 6.16%, Japan: 2.51%, Spain: 2.49%). Stratified by SjD diagnostic criteria (1993 European, 2002 AECG) and AIH scoring (1993 IAIHG), prevalence was approximately 2%. CONCLUSION: Prevalence of AIH in SjD patients varies significantly by study design and region. Early diagnosis and treatment of AIH may improve quality of life and prognosis in SjD patients. NOVEL INSIGHTS: This meta-analysis provides the first pooled estimate regarding the prevalence of autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) in patients with Sjögren disease (SjD): 2.55% (95% CI 1.52%-4.26%; 14 studies, 3697 patients). Subgroup analyses indicated that AIH prevalence was influenced by study design, whereas estimates stratified by SjD and AIH diagnostic criteria were of similar magnitude (approximately 2%). Regional estimates showed numerical differences, but the differences were not statistically significant; the numerically higher estimates may reflect differences in genetic susceptibility, selection bias, environmental factors, and medical screening strategies, as well as referral and detection bias. Given the observational and largely cross-sectional design of the included studies, these estimates only motivate a hypothesis-generating immunometabolic framework, rather than permitting causal or mechanistic inference. In this framework, the liver may serve as a source of autoantigens through modifications of oxidation, glycosylation, and lipidation, including the hepatocyte β2GPI-PON1 axis; this mechanism remains to be tested in the SjD-AIH overlap.

summary.takeaway: 该系统综述与荟萃分析首次合并估计干燥综合征（SjD）患者中自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）的患病率为2.55%，并指出该估计受研究设计和地区影响。
summary.methods: 检索Web of Science、Cochrane、Embase、PubMed、CNKI、万方、CBMdisc、维普至2025年11月14日，纳入14项研究（3697例SjD患者），用NOS和JBI量表评估质量，以R 4.5.2进行荟萃分析（PROSPERO: CRD420251233495），并按研究类型、国家及SjD和AIH诊断标准做亚组分析。
summary.relevance: 该文与“机制推理”主题相关：作者基于观察性患病率数据提出一个假设生成性的免疫代谢框架，设想肝脏通过氧化、糖基化、脂化修饰（包括肝细胞β2GPI-PON1轴）产生自身抗原，作为SjD与AIH重叠的可能机制线索。
summary.caveat: 纳入研究多为观察性且以横断面设计为主，摘要明确说明这些估计只能用于提出假设，不能支持因果或机制推断；地区间数值差异未达统计学显著，可能受遗传易感性、选择偏倚、环境因素、筛查策略及转诊和检出偏倚影响，所提β2GPI-PON1轴机制尚待验证。
